title: QUIZ - 93
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Identifying Increasing, Decreasing, and Constant Trends
questions.learningObjective: Identify whether a set of graphed values is increasing, decreasing, or constant
questions.question: What trend is shown by the data {(1, 11), (2, 11), (3, 11), (4, 11)}?

options.label: A
options.text: The values fluctuate randomly with no clear pattern.

options.label: B
options.text: The values are increasing as x increases.

options.label: C
options.text: The values are decreasing as x increases.

options.label: D
options.text: The values are constant as x increases.

questions.explanation: Looking at consecutive y-values, they are constant as x increases from 1 to 4.
questions.hint: Compare each y-value to the one before it to determine whether values are rising, falling, or staying the same.

questions.learningObjective: Identify a trend that changes direction partway through the data
questions.question: Describe the overall trend shown by the data {(1, 5), (2, 11), (3, 12), (4, 14), (5, 4)}.

options.label: A
options.text: The values decrease throughout.

options.label: B
options.text: The values increase at first, then decrease.

options.label: C
options.text: The values increase throughout.

options.label: D
options.text: The values decrease at first, then increase.

questions.explanation: From x=1 to x=3, the values rise ([5, 11, 12]); from x=3 to x=5, the values fall ([14, 4]), showing an increase followed by a decrease.
questions.hint: Look for a turning point where the values switch from rising to falling, or vice versa.
